rationale: Selected joint boundary (selection de4d95e2): 13 fp32 SUM allreduces per step (12x 28,351,488B buckets + 1x 157,541,376B bucket, RING over SHM/PCIe, 2 channels, no NVLink) are transport-bound at ~34.4 ms per the collective_calibration collector, while the clean baseline max-rank objective is 45.13 ms (rank1) vs 35.70 ms (rank0). The ~10 ms max-rank excess is in-kernel device waiting: execution_timeline attributes it to a near-constant ~12.7 ms inter-rank CPU/GPU submission lag on the first allreduce plus 0.5-1.9 ms per-bucket readiness jitter, with the waiting rank flipping across captures. The payload, bucket count/cap, DDP wrapper, no_sync schedule and c10d::allreduce_ sites are frozen, so no communication-side edit is legal or profitable; the only editable cause of the waiting is host-side submission skew, and the step spends it in Python dispatch: python_runtime measures 608 module _call_impl, 1212 module __getattr__, 536 config __getattribute__ and 288 eager_router calls per step across the 12-layer eager path. This candidate returns one replacement per observed GPT2Block module site (group 3b09e47895ee88ac921d, 12 sites x 4 microbatch invocations per step): a fused composite that reproduces the installed transformers 5.16.1 eager block path kernel-for-kernel with identical tensor shapes/strides/operand order - native_layer_norm, addmm(c_attn), view/split/view/transpose, bmm(q,k^T), mul.Scalar(0.125), add.Tensor(causal mask), _softmax, bmm(w,v), transpose+reshape(clone), addmm(attn c_proj), add.Tensor(residual), native_layer_norm, addmm(c_fc), tanh-formula NewGELU (pow, mul, add, mul, tanh, add, mul), addmm(mlp c_proj), add.Tensor(residual) - while removing the per-block module _call_impl chains, GPT2Attention cache/cross-attention branching and ALL_ATTENTION_FUNCTIONS interface lookup, Conv1D/NewGELU/LayerNorm/Dropout module hops. The parent's p=0.0 dropout calls and float32->float32 Tensor.type are identity operations (verified F.dropout(x, 0.0, True) is x and x.type(torch.float32) is x) and are skipped without numeric effect. Strictly less host work with the same GPU kernels leaves step_ms safe under the 1.05x constraint, and reduced host submission time and jitter should align the two ranks' bucket readiness during the final backward so the waiting rank's ncclDevKernel_AllReduce spin shrinks toward the fast rank's ~35-37 ms level, with the ~34.4 ms calibration floor bounding any result. This is the selection's causal hypothesis under test, not a guaranteed win: if the waiting is dominated by non-host factors (OS scheduling, clock variance), the objective stays near 45 ms even though step_ms improves. Correctness: CPU validation with the exact frozen architecture (seed 20261020, transformers 5.16.1, torch 2.13) shows bitwise-equal loss, logits, every gradient, two-microbatch accumulated gradients and post-SGD parameters versus the untouched parent path, because the composite issues the identical aten kernels on identical tensors, so the DDP world-average gradients remain exactly replica-identical (atol=rtol=0 check) and within 1e-6/1e-4 of the serial global-batch reference. Each replacement validates its invocation (no past_key_values, no encoder inputs, use_cache false, fp32 3D hidden of width 768, fp32 4D-or-None mask, only parent-ignored extra kwargs) and otherwise calls the bound parent forward with the original args; build-time guard failures install a labelled parent passthrough (fallback:gpt2_block:setup_guard) so setup failure stays an observable category. Route labels composite:gpt2_block:eager_fused / fallback:gpt2_block:signature are reported per invocation via context['record_route']. Eliminated inner calls (listed) are the observed module invocations inside the replaced blocks that no longer occur: the selected GPT2Attention/GPT2MLP/Conv1D/NewGELUActivation sites (84) plus the block-inner LayerNorm (24) and Dropout (24) module hops; their consumers remain valid because the composite returns the same block output tensor the parent returned (GPT2Model's loop and residual adds consume it unchanged), and every inner aten operation is still issued identically through normal dispatch (addmm/bmm/_softmax/native_layer_norm/tanh/pow/clone/add/mul), so no computational work disappears and no functional replacements are installed. DDP semantics are untouched: the same parameters receive the same gradients in the same ready order, bucket payload and allreduce structure are unchanged, both ranks install the identical 12-site mapping, and no collective, hook or profiler interaction is introduced. No inputs/previous-feedback.txt and no inputs/previous-candidate/ exist for this attempt; the first-try rationale is corroborated by the actual selection input and collector records cited above.

setup_work.description: Build-time work is host-only and constant per GPT2Block site: resolve the child modules (ln_1, ln_2, attn.c_attn, attn.c_proj, mlp.c_fc, mlp.c_proj), read constants (eps=1e-5, scaling=0.125, heads=12, head_dim=64, split 768, intermediate 3072, NewGELU sqrt(2/pi)) and verify structural guards (eager attention, reorder_and_upcast_attn False, all dropout p==0, weight shapes, no cross-attention). 12 Python closures are created; no CUDA kernel is launched, no device memory is allocated, and no parameter bytes are copied or packed: the closures alias the live nn.Parameter objects, so optimizer.step() in-place updates and reset() load_state_dict in-place copies remain visible for every subsequent warm-model invocation. Expected setup allocation: < 100 KB host objects, 0 B device memory; framework.peak_allocated/reserved and lifecycle peaks should be unaffected.
setup_work.parameter_transforms: none (live parameter aliasing only; packed copies would go stale under SGD in-place updates)

quality_risks: Bitwise-identical numerics rely on the installed transformers 5.16.1 eager GPT-2 code path matching the inspected source; structural deviations are caught by build guards (labelled fallback:gpt2_block:setup_guard passthrough) or per-call signature checks (fallback:gpt2_block:signature to the bound parent), so correctness never depends on the fast path being taken.

The communication objective improvement is a causal hypothesis: if the waiting rank's ~10 ms excess is driven mainly by non-host factors (OS scheduling, GPU clock variance outside the model), communication_kernel_sum_ms will stay near 45 ms even though step_ms improves; the 3-sample max-rank median directly exposes this, and the ~34.4 ms transport floor bounds any achievable objective.

Coverage counts the 12 installed sites (4 invocations each per step during the gradient_accumulation phase); no replacements are installed at inner module or functional sites, and the eliminated inner invocations are declared in eliminated_calls so the plan can be recaptured.

Cross-rank exactness (atol=rtol=0 replica check) is preserved because the per-rank forward is bitwise deterministic and identical to the parent's; DDP still produces the same world-average gradients over the same buckets.

No CUDA Graph capture and no collectives are introduced, so the torch_communication collector's separately profiled invocations observe the same 13 allreduces with unchanged payload; the profiler trace kernel set is unchanged (same kernels, one aten kernel per original non-identity op).
